visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Rotate In Place
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A second matrix is filled with r[j][2 - i] = m[i][j] and then copied back. Rotate in place with a transpose followed by a row reversal. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Transposing then reversing rows rotates the matrix using constant extra memory. The version with a second matrix needs a copy of the entire grid, which is costly for big images.
